name: Direct2Care
area: Eligible Hueytown team members and household members
benefit: Virtual medical care and mental wellbeing support through your existing benefit.
steps: Open the patient portal. Use Find Me if you cannot locate your invitation. If your details do not match, ask customer care for activation help.
check: Confirm your enrollment, household access, counseling session rules and any outside-service costs. Do not enter medical details here.

name: Childcare Resources
area: Ask for Hueytown 35023 and your commute area
benefit: A customized search for care that fits your child and work schedule.
steps: Call 205-945-0018 and ask for extension 307. Give ages, days, full drop-off and pickup window, budget and preferred area.
check: Ask for actual openings, infant care, early hours, Saturday care, school pickup and subsidy acceptance. Referrals are not reserved places.

name: Child Care Central
area: Jefferson County; also Blount, Shelby, St. Clair and Walker
benefit: Help paying for childcare for qualifying families pursuing work or education.
steps: Call to request the current application route, eligibility screening, document checklist and waitlist status.
check: Your home county controls the office. Do not send income records or child documents to the restaurant portal. Approval and provider acceptance are separate.

name: Hueytown First Methodist Child Care Center
benefit: The center lists care from six weeks through age five.
steps: Call the childcare center directly to ask about your child’s age group, opening hours, fees and tours.
check: An interest form does not reserve a space. Current openings, hours, prices and DHR status must be confirmed before choosing care.

name: Brooklane Baptist Childcare
benefit: Publishes weekday care from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m., with toddler and school-age programs.
steps: Call with your child’s age and school, if relevant. Ask about spaces, total weekly cost and school transport.
check: A 6 a.m. opening does not cover a 5 a.m. shift. Published pricing needs reconfirmation. Check current licensing or exemption status with Alabama DHR.

name: Ride United through 211
area: Hueytown trip must be checked individually
benefit: Qualifying work trips can be arranged through 211 without a Lyft app or smartphone.
steps: Call with pickup, restaurant destination, arrival deadline, return trip and accessibility needs.
check: Ask about both directions, hours, advance notice, limits and rider requirements. A referral or request is not a confirmed ride.

name: MAX trip planning
benefit: Check whether a scheduled route can cover part of your commute.
steps: Ask customer service to check the exact start and end addresses and your earliest arrival and latest return.
check: Bessemer service does not prove service to the restaurant. Confirm stops, transfers, final walking distance and Saturday times.

name: Hueytown First Methodist pantry and clothing closet
benefit: Food and clothing assistance close to the restaurant.
steps: Call the church office to ask whether you qualify and how to arrange pickup.
check: Confirm distribution hours, identification requirements, referral rules and current availability before traveling.

name: Community Food Bank food finder
benefit: Find a nearby pantry or mobile distribution.
steps: Use Find Food and confirm the selected distribution’s current date and intake rules.
check: The Bessemer warehouse is not a walk-in food pickup site. Use listed distributions or partners.

name: Community Action Agency Bessemer
area: Jefferson County intake; confirm your address
benefit: Energy assistance plus screening for other current family support.
steps: Call the Bessemer office or use its appointment link. Mention any shutoff date immediately.
check: Ask what is open today and which documents to provide. Rental aid, fuel or other assistance depends on program and funding.

name: Alabama food assistance
steps: Apply through MyDHR, or call Bessemer Food Assistance to ask about a paper application and the correct county office.
check: Online application requires an account. Paper applications can be mailed, faxed or delivered to DHR. Ask about urgent food needs directly.

name: WIC and Jefferson County clinics
area: Jefferson County; ask about Western Health Center in Midfield
kind: Eligibility based health and nutrition services
benefit: A route to WIC screening and local clinic appointments.
steps: Call JCDH and ask for WIC or the service you need, with an appointment near Hueytown.
check: Confirm participant eligibility, documents, clinic location and cost. Western Health Center is in Midfield, not Hueytown.

name: ALL Kids and children’s Medicaid application
benefit: Low-cost comprehensive coverage screening for eligible children under 19.
steps: Use the official children’s coverage application or call for help or a paper form.
check: Program staff decide eligibility and costs. Direct2Care does not replace comprehensive hospital coverage.

name: Legal Services Alabama
benefit: Apply for civil legal help, including housing problems.
steps: Call 866-456-4995; Spanish intake is 888-835-3505. Mention any court or eviction deadline first.
check: An application is not acceptance of representation. Contact the provider directly about your case.

name: First Response Workplace Conduct Solutions
benefit: Find the appropriate route for workplace concerns.
steps: Use the reporting instructions on the restaurant hotline poster or handbook. If you cannot find them, call First Response to request the correct Hueytown reporting route.
check: 888-812-9055 is the published business contact; Hueytown-specific hotline instructions still need confirmation. Reports may be shared with employer contacts.

name: Remarkable Futures and tuition discounts
benefit: Explore scholarship opportunities and participating school tuition discounts.
steps: Open the official program page and ask the restaurant training leader about application support.
check: Check the live scholarship cycle and deadlines. Discounts vary by school; free college tuition is not established as a Hueytown benefit.

name: Lawson State Adult Education
benefit: Explore GED preparation and adult education close to Hueytown.
steps: Open the adult education page and request current class locations, enrollment steps and times.
check: Confirm which classes are available in Bessemer, any online option, age requirements and conditions for test assistance.

name: Free tax preparation
area: Central Alabama; local or remote route depends on season
benefit: Ask about free tax preparation and an accessible location.
steps: Call 211 to ask about current tax help, appointment locations and the applicable income limit.
check: Local program thresholds can differ from national VITA guidance. Recheck before the next filing season; do not assume appointments are open now.

name: 211 Alabama
area: Route by your actual home ZIP and county
benefit: Find additional help with housing, disability, caregiving, veterans’ needs and other local resources.
steps: Call 211. If it does not connect locally, call 888-421-1266. You can text your ZIP code to 898-211.
check: Tell the specialist Hueytown, Alabama, and your home ZIP. General text access does not guarantee ride booking by text.
